honesty_check:
LINK AUDIT METHOD MATTERS MORE THAN THE RESULT HERE. All 13 URLs returned HTTP 200 with -L and a browser UA — but that number is worthless on this site. career.crisil.com is an Angular SPA: I fetched a deliberately nonsensical slug (/jobview/this-job-does-not-exist-9999999999999) and it returned HTTP 200 with a byte-identical 40,792-byte shell (the only diff was the Akamai beacon nonce). A 200 here proves the CDN is up, nothing else. Zero 403s were seen, so no bot-blocking distinction arose.

Real verification came from two independent sources. (1) The Zwayam detail API (POST public.zwayam.com/jobs-service/v1/jobs/careersite, companyId 15438): the fake slug returns HTTP 404 {"message":"This job is no longer accepting applications."}, while all 13 picks returned 200 with full payloads (status=1, real JD text, skill tags, education fields). (2) A complete 70-page crawl of the public search feed (POST public.zwayam.com/jobs/search): all 13 appear, all status=1. So all 13 are genuinely live and none is a dead link — still_live=true across the board, honestly earned rather than inferred from a 200.

WHERE THE SCREEN WAS RIGHT AND I INITIALLY DOUBTED IT: the detail endpoint returns a lastAppliedOnDate that rolls to roughly "now" on every call, which looked like a deadline. The search feed shows lastAppliedOnDate=None on all 674 reqs. The screen's "no deadlines anywhere" claim is CORRECT; I am recording that I tried to refute it and failed. noOfApplications is likewise None on all 674, confirming the screen's own caveat not to read it as "nobody applied".

THREE THINGS THE SCREEN GOT WRONG THAT IT DID NOT FLAG:
1. The feed now returns totalCount 674, not the 678 the screen recorded roughly a day earlier. Four reqs left the feed in about 24 hours. "CRISIL never expires postings" is therefore too strong — it prunes, just slowly.
2. Req 20511, the screen's #2 pick at score 90, carries ijpEnabled=True. It is the ONLY one of the 13 flagged as an internal job posting (61 of 674 are). The screen cited that same field in its referral strategy but never checked it against its own picks. Internal staff are being routed to this req in parallel.
3. Req 20755's experience is 3-8 years in the ATS metadata, not the 2-5 the screen quoted from the JD body. The screen declared "the JD body is the operative text" — but the metadata is what the filter reads, and both numbers bury 13 months of internships either way.

MY OWN LIMIT: I verified existence, posted requirements and reachability. I could not test whether the apply form accepts a submission without actually submitting one, and I cannot see the recruiter's internal shortlist. "Live in the feed" is not "seat still unfilled" — for the three reqs untouched since January-March 2026 that gap is wide.

verified_picks.title: Intern (FS Consulting) — MI&A, Mumbai, req 21209
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell, meaningless); Zwayam detail API 200 with full payload; present in public feed, status=1
verified_picks.reason: I tried hard to break this one and could not. Verified JD text reads verbatim: 'Qualifications & Requirements: Students pursuing MBA/Btech/BBA/Bcom/CA /CFA'. Btech is named. Education field is 'pursuing UG/PG'. Experience 0-1. Mandatory skill tags are 'Excel, PowerPoint, Data Analysis, Research' — no tool he lacks, no credential he lacks, no seniority marker in title or slug. It is an intern seat, so a May-2027 graduate is the intended candidate, not an exception. Posted 08-Sep-2026 and modified 10-Sep-2026, making it the freshest B.Tech-accessible intern req in all 674. The why_fit survives a 30-second screen: CypherSOL was a Mumbai fintech where he shipped ML over bank statements, and the JD's first line is 'data driven analysis to provide support in execution of consulting projects for Banks/NBFCs'. Two small deflations. First, the entire JD is three sentences, so the screen's dense bullet-by-bullet matching is reading more specificity into it than exists — a recruiter has almost no posted criteria to match against, which cuts both ways. Second, the screen quoted 'strong analytical and secondary research skills' as a match target, but that phrase sits inside the 'Preferred Experience' line alongside 'Prior exposure to Banks, NBFCs' which he genuinely does not have. He is at the edge of preferred, not inside it. Score trimmed 92 to 88. This is the one application slot at CRISIL that is unambiguously worth spending.

verified_picks.title: Internship Trainee - AI Engg. — Data and AI, Pune;Mumbai, req 20511
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1, modified 15-Sep-2026
verified_picks.reason: Eligibility holds and I could not refute it. Full verified JD is three sentences: 'Candidate looking for 4 - 6 months of internship in the field of AI. Preferrably candidates from mathematics and enggineering backgroung. The candidate will working closely with the AI engginers and asissting them on Live projects.' Education field 'Undergraduates in Engineering or Mathematics field' — he is an undergraduate until May 2027. Experience 0-1. Skill tags Coding, Python, Machine Learning — all his. Jan-May 2027 is 5 months, inside the stated 4-6. Modified 15-Sep-2026, ten days ago, the most recently touched of all 13, which is the strongest liveness signal in the set and better than the screen's 'posted 23-Jun' framing implied. BUT THE SCREEN MISSED A MATERIAL FLAG: ijpEnabled=True. This is the only one of the 13 marked as an internal job posting (61 of 674 carry it). CRISIL is routing this req to existing employees in parallel with the public feed, so he is not competing in an empty room. Second correction: the location string is ordered 'Pune, Maharashtra, India;Mumbai, Maharashtra, India' — Pune is the primary listing, so a Mumbai seat is not guaranteed and must be confirmed before he commits. Third, the screen called this 'the strongest timing fit in the entire feed' at 90; a three-sentence typo-ridden JD with an internal-posting flag does not support a 90. Score 90 to 80. Still keep — the bar is genuinely below him and the department is the right one.

verified_picks.title: Intern - SQL Developer — MI&A, Mumbai, req 18806
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1, modified 02-Feb-2026
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED ON THE SCREEN'S CENTRAL CLAIM. The screen scored this 'yes' at 84 on the strength of the JD body ('Need to hire a intern with basic SQL knowledge') and the education field ('B.Tech / CDAC / MCA'), both of which I confirmed verbatim. What it buried is the mandatory skill tag list, which I pulled from the API: 'Pl / Sql Development, SQL, Python, SQL Queries, Stored Procedures'. PL/SQL development and stored procedures are in the REQUIRED tag set — the field a Zwayam recruiter actually filters and keyword-matches on — not in a preferred section. He writes application-layer SQL through SQLAlchemy and has never written a stored procedure or a PL/SQL package. By the strict rule, a lacked skill sitting in the basic quals means stretch at best, not yes. The screen listed this gap under 'gaps' and then scored as if it did not exist. Second problem the screen underweighted: last modified 02-Feb-2026, nearly eight months untouched, versus 20511 touched ten days ago. Kept anyway, but conditionally: the 2-3 week advanced-SQL block (window functions, CTEs, views, stored procedures, basic PL/SQL) is the single highest-leverage thing he can learn for this entire company, he has said he will do it, and it converts this from a bluff into a true claim. Apply AFTER that block, not before. Score 84 to 58.

verified_picks.title: Apprentice - Metadata Management & Data Cataloging — Data and AI, Mumbai, req 20943
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1, jobVisibiltyLevel=L
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED as 'yes'. Three problems the screen waved through. (1) The education field reads 'Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Applications (MCA)'. That is a named degree he does not hold. The screen called it 'adjacent and rarely disqualifying at apprentice grade' — that is an assumption, not evidence, and the rule is that a credential named in the required quals counts against him. B.Tech CSE is not MCA. (2) The entire req is one platform: the verified JD says the role is to 'support the Data Office in the implementation and ongoing configuration of the OpenMetadata platform'. He has zero exposure to OpenMetadata and zero data-governance vocabulary. A req whose whole subject is a tool he has never opened is not a 'yes'. (3) TIMING, which the screen actively spun. It framed his May-2027 graduation as 'a continuity advantage'. Indian apprenticeships under NAPS/NATS commonly run 12 months and are generally structured for recent graduates rather than students still enrolled. A 12-month apprenticeship cannot start in January 2027 for someone whose final semester ends in May. The screen never checked the duration and should have. One more note: jobVisibiltyLevel is 'L', which only 20 of 674 reqs carry; it is still publicly listed so this does not block him, but it is an unexplained non-default. KEPT, narrowly, for one reason only: the OpenMetadata weekend build (Docker, ingest a Postgres schema, glossary, lineage, RBAC, write it up) is free, genuinely cheap, and would plausibly make him the only applicant with hands-on experience of the exact named platform. Do the project first, and confirm the apprenticeship duration in the first message. Score 76 to 55.

verified_picks.title: Generative AI Intern — Data and AI, PUNE ONLY, req 18501
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1, modified 21-Jan-2026
verified_picks.reason: ELIGIBILITY CONFIRMED, SCORE REFUTED. The eligibility is clean and I could not break it: education field is a bare 'B.Tech', there is no experience range at all, and the verified required-skills list ('Strong knowledge of Python programming', 'Basic understanding of Generative AI and LLMs', 'Transformers (basic understanding)', 'NumPy, Pandas (basic level)') asks for BASIC where he operates well above. Hugging Face and OpenAI APIs are explicitly marked '(preferred)', so they are not a gate. But an 88 is indefensible on two facts the screen mentioned and then did not price in. (1) LOCATION: Pune only, no Mumbai option anywhere in the record. He is Mumbai-based and this would mean relocating for a five-month internship. (2) STALENESS, and this is the decisive one: last modified 21-Jan-2026 — eight months and four days without a single touch, against 20511 in the same department touched ten days ago. The screen called 18501 'the highest-overlap req in the whole 678-job feed' and scored it third overall; a seat nobody has edited since January, requiring relocation, cannot rank third. Kept only because it is one form on a portal he is already using and eligibility is genuinely unimpeachable. Treat it strictly as a rider on the 20511 conversation, never as a plan. Score 88 to 52.

verified_picks.title: Intern (FS Consulting, second req) — MI&A, Mumbai, req 21014
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED to 'no'. The verified qualification line reads, in full: 'Qualifications & Requirements: Students pursuing BBA/Bcom/CA /CFA'. B.Tech is absent. This is not an oversight in the posting — and the timeline proves it. 21014 was posted 25-Aug-2026 without Btech; its sibling 21209 was posted two weeks later on 08-Sep-2026 WITH 'Btech' inserted into the same sentence. CRISIL deliberately widened the qualification set on the newer req. Applying to the older, narrower one, which explicitly enumerates a degree set he is outside of, is applying to a req that excludes him while its twin includes him. The screen's counter was that the education field still says 'pursuing UG/PG' — true, but the free-text qualification line is the more specific instruction and a recruiter reads it. keep=false is not a claim it is worthless; it is a claim it deserves zero separate application slot. Its entire value is one sentence in the email to the 21209 recruiter ('I see two intern seats open on the FS consulting team'), which costs nothing and captures the same upside. Score 74 to 20.

verified_picks.title: Contract Implementation Specialist, VoC Research — GIX-GBA, Mumbai;Gurugram, req 21123
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1, posted 02-Sep-2026
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED, and this is the screen's worst piece of reasoning. It argued that 'proficient in Python OR Excel VBA' means 'the "or" is doing real work: his strong Python alone satisfies this, and he does not need the VBA he lacks.' Three verified facts destroy that. (1) The mandatory skill tag list on this req reads 'VBA Excel, Data Analytics, Data Visualization'. VBA Excel is the FIRST tag — the lead keyword a recruiter screens on. The screen never quoted the tag list. (2) The same required-skills bullet continues '...and experience with reporting tools (e.g., QlikView, NPrinting)' — that clause is joined by AND, sits inside 'Required Experience & Skills', not a preferred section, and he has neither tool. The responsibilities line is likewise 'using Python/VBA, SQL, and QlikView/NPrinting'. A lacked tool in the required quals is a hard fail by the stated rule. (3) EXPERIENCE: 2 to 5 years in the ATS metadata against ~13 months of internships. The screen tried to argue past this by noting the JD body sets no number — but the body opens 'We are seeking a hands-on Contract Implementation Specialist' and requires a 'Hands-on background in technical implementation, reporting development, or system configuration', which is not a fresher brief. Add that it is full-time (he cannot start before June 2027) and that the JD closes with 'Note that the technical skills may be tested as part of the interview process' — a live SQL and reporting-tool screen he would walk into short two named tools. Score 68 to 18.

verified_picks.title: Investor Reporting Analyst — GR&RS, Mumbai;Pune;Gurgaon;Chennai, req 20902
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED. The screen built this pick on a 'RARE INVERSION' — that 'BE (Computers/IT) mandatory' puts him inside the gate for once. Read the whole education field: 'BE (Computers/IT) mandatory, MBA (Finance), CFA'. The most natural reading is BE as a floor PLUS a finance credential, not BE as a sufficient condition; he holds neither MBA (Finance) nor CFA. But the decisive evidence is the mandatory skill tag set, which the screen never cited: 'Investment Performance, Performance Analyst, Performance Attribution, Client Reporting, Investor Reporting'. He matches ZERO of five. Every single screening keyword on this req is a domain skill absent from his resume. That is precisely the flattery-that-collapses-in-30-seconds test: the screen's why_fit leaned on 'Ability to work with SQL and Python comfortably', which I verified is the very last bullet of the responsibilities, and on presentation-formatting bullets that any MBA intern matches better than he does. The screen itself conceded he cannot speak to time-weighted return or Brinson attribution — which is the actual job. Finally it is full-time: a six-week-old req that will be filled long before June 2027. The experience band (0-2) is the one thing genuinely in his favour and it is not enough. Not an application slot; at most one sentence in a GR&RS referral conversation. Score 72 to 22.

verified_picks.title: Data Quality & Transformation Analyst (SQL / Testing) — GR&RS, Mumbai, req 20755
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED on both the experience bar and the Tableau argument. EXPERIENCE: the ATS metadata says 3 to 8 years; the JD body says 2-5. The screen asserted 'the JD body is the operative text' and quoted the lower figure — but the metadata is what the portal filter reads, and both figures bury ~13 months of internships. The stated rule is unambiguous: highest posted requirement exceeds 13 months means no, not stretch. TABLEAU: the screen's most attractive claim was that 'CRISIL is explicitly offering to close his single largest BI-tool gap' because the JD says 'Tableau skills are a plus (mid-level preferred), and training will be provided'. That sentence is real. What the screen omitted is that the same JD's Key Responsibilities also demand 'Work with Tableau - Knowledgeable of dashboard performance optimization techniques' and 'Experience LEADING data visualization approaches for projects, developing innovative approaches, and enterprise dashboard rollouts and adoption'. No training clause covers 'experience leading enterprise dashboard rollouts' — that is a senior responsibility, and Tableau also sits in the mandatory skill tags ('SQL, Tableau, Pl / Sql Development, Data validation, Data quality', which additionally re-surfaces the PL/SQL he lacks). Add full-time with a June 2027 start against a req posted July 2026. The favourable education line ('Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering') is real and irrelevant next to a 3-8 year bar. Score 58 to 12.

verified_picks.title: Analyst - Ratings Research & Development (R&D) — GAC, Pune (Hybrid), req 19513
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1, modified 20-Mar-2026
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED. The screen made the blank experience field the headline ('extraordinary... his main opening') and treated the degree line as a soft preference a manager would override. The verified requirement is the very first line under Requirements: 'Master's degree with some financial report writing skills, with background in either sustainability, credit research or private markets.' The ATS education field is simply 'Masters'. That is a credential he lacks, stated as a requirement, and it is compounded — he also has none of the three named domain backgrounds (sustainability/ESG, credit research, private markets), and the role's domain work is automating extraction from CSRD/TCFD reports and CDP filings and analysing private credit. The screen conceded 'NO certification fixes it' and then still scored it 56 as a stretch; those two statements cannot both stand. Also Pune, not Mumbai, and untouched since 20-Mar-2026 (six months). The Python/SQL match is genuinely strong and entirely beside the point when the first requirement line is a degree he will not hold. Score 56 to 10.

verified_picks.title: Senior Research Analyst - Automation — GR&RS, Pune;Mumbai, req 20805
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1
verified_picks.reason: CONFIRMED 'no' — the screen was already honest here and I am not overturning it. Verified: 'Senior' sits in the title (a seniority marker by the stated rule), experience is 2 to 5 years in the metadata (the screen said 2-4 from the body; either way it is roughly two years beyond him), and the education field is 'Masters in Technoloy/Engineering/Computer Science with CFA L1/2' — two credentials he lacks, stacked. Alteryx is named twice in the responsibilities ('largely utilizing Alteryx and Python', 'Design, build, and maintain automated data workflows using Alteryx') and appears in the mandatory skill tags; he has none. The JD body also reveals the req is really a 'Client Reporting Specialist supporting a private credit asset manager covering US and European private credit investments', which is further from his profile than the title suggests. One small correction to the screen's framing: it kept this in the shortlist as 'directional' intelligence about which tools CRISIL's BI ladder runs on. That is fine as a note but it is not a pick, and it should never have occupied a shortlist row. Score 38 to 5.

verified_picks.title: Analyst - Credit & Counterparty Risk — MI&A, Pune;Mumbai, req 20676
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1
verified_picks.reason: CONFIRMED 'no'; the screen was straight about this one. Verified education field: 'MBA Graduation in Finance, CA Inter, CA, CFA' — four credentials, he holds none. Verified JD opening line: 'Analyst with 2 to 3 years of experience', metadata 2 to 3 years, against ~13 months. The mandatory skill tag is a single entry, 'Report Writing'. The core work is P&L, balance-sheet, cash-flow and ratio analysis benchmarked against peers, fund-diversion and related-party-transaction analysis, plus face-to-face interactions with CEOs/MDs/CFOs. He has never done any of it. The screen's one genuine insight survives and is worth preserving: the JD does literally contain the line 'Bank statements/GST data/ credit bureau data analysis', which is verbatim what he built at CypherSOL, and that sentence is unusually persuasive spoken to an MI&A human. But that is referral talking-material, exactly as the screen said — not an application. A cold submission dies on the education field in seconds and burns a slot. Score 28 to 5.

verified_picks.title: Intern - Financial services research — MI&A, Mumbai, req 18254
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (SPA shell); Zwayam API 200; in public feed, status=1, modified 02-Feb-2026
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED. The screen called this 'THE ESCAPE HATCH' and said 'a B.Tech DS student with an analytics certification lands in it'. The verified clause is: 'Students pursuing MBA / CA / CFA Level 1–2, or those with fintech, digital lending, or analytics certifications preferred'. Note what it actually does — it names a student set (MBA/CA/CFA) he is outside of, then adds an alternative that is itself marked 'preferred', not qualifying. And he holds NO analytics certification today; the screen admitted this in its gaps section (AWS Academy ML Foundations and Google Cloud GenAI Skills Boost are not analytics certifications) and then scored the req as though the hatch were already open. As of 25 Sep 2026 he fails the qualification line outright. The rest of the req is domain he does not have: the JD's second responsibility is 'Analyse the broader fintech landscape—lending tech, insuretech, embedded finance, and regulatory developments'. Insuretech, embedded finance and Indian fintech regulation are blank on his resume. And it is the stalest intern req in the set: posted 12-Dec-2025, last modified 02-Feb-2026 — 7.7 months untouched. A req that requires him to first spend 3-5 weeks buying a NISM or Google certificate, and that nobody has edited since February, is not worth an application slot. The NISM Research Analyst cert may still be worth doing for its signal across MI&A generally — but do not do it for this posting. Score 66 to 15.

final_recommendation: Five of the thirteen survive, and only one is unreserved: apply to req 21209 (Intern, MI&A FS Consulting, Mumbai) this week at the apply_url — it is verified live, freshest in the set (08-Sep-2026), and is the single CRISIL req whose posted qualification line literally names 'Btech' alongside an education field of 'pursuing UG/PG', so his May-2027 graduation is the intended profile rather than an exception. In the same sitting, submit 20511 (Internship Trainee - AI Engg., Data and AI) and mention 21014 by name in the email to the 21209 recruiter rather than filing it separately, since 21014's quals list BBA/Bcom/CA/CFA and pointedly omit Btech that its sibling added two weeks later. Then hold 18806 and 20943 until he has done the two cheap pieces of prep that convert them from bluffs into true claims — 2-3 weeks of advanced SQL including stored procedures and basic PL/SQL for 18806 (whose mandatory skill tags, not just its preferred section, name both), and one weekend standing up OpenMetadata in Docker with a glossary, lineage and RBAC for 20943 — and confirm the apprenticeship duration before committing, because a standard 12-month Indian apprenticeship cannot start in January against a May graduation. Treat 18501 as a one-form rider only: eligibility is clean but it is Pune-only and has not been touched since 21-Jan-2026. Everything else is dead on arrival for a cold application — 21123, 20755 and 20805 carry required tools he lacks (QlikView/NPrinting, Tableau-at-leadership-level, Alteryx) plus 2-8 year bars, 19513 and 20676 demand a Master's or MBA/CA/CFA, and 20902 matches zero of its five mandatory skill tags — so spend the finite referral capital on MI&A (21209) and Data and AI (20511, 20943), use the verbatim 'Bank statements/GST data/credit bureau data analysis' line from 20676 purely as conversation material with a human, and in parallel ask the DJSCE T&P cell about CRISIL's 2026-27 campus calendar, which is genuinely invisible from this public feed.
